items.title: The pullback of the quasi-coherent module associated to a module is associated to the base changed module
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file modules.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the pullback of the quasi-coherent module associated to a module with the module associated to the base change of that module along the ring map on global sections (author lemma at source lines 1433-1445, label lemma-restrict-quasi-coherent). The proof (source lines 1447-1461) rewrites the associated module as a pullback along the structure morphism to the one point space and applies the compatibility of pullbacks with the composition of the morphisms in the displayed commutative square (proof lines 1448-1460). The reduction to the composition rule is the content. H2.
